title: Sail with us
intro:
Eagle Ray Expeditions builds private sailing trips around your group, not the other way around.
You choose who comes. Our team runs the boat, keeps everyone safe, and reads the day so it can change when something worth changing it for shows up.

expeditions.name: Recalibration Expedition
expeditions.description: Slow down the pace. Fewer miles, more time in the water, nothing fixed ahead of time. For groups who want the sea to reset something, not fill a schedule.

expeditions.name: Active Expedition
expeditions.description: Built for groups who want to move: diving, kiting, longer sails, early starts. The crew keeps the days full and the plan flexible around conditions.

seo.title: Sail with Us — Eagle Ray Expeditions
seo.description: Private sailing expeditions in La Paz, built around your group. Choose an expedition and plan your trip.
